Chaining the constraints fixes the order:

- Finn is right after Elif and Gus is right after Finn, so Elif, Finn, Gus are consecutive.
- Hana is right after Ben, so Ben, Hana are consecutive.
- Ben is before Finn, and Finn is right after Elif, so Ben is before Elif. Ben and Elif can't be adjacent, because Hana sits right after Ben. So Elif is at least two slots after Ben, which puts Hana before Elif.
- Cara is before Dev, and Dev is before Ben. That gives Cara, Dev, Ben, Hana, then Elif, Finn, Gus.
- Ivo is right after Ann, and Ivo is after Gus. Ann can't be Gus, so Ann and Ivo come after Gus.

That uses all nine slots in one order: Cara, Dev, Ben, Hana, Elif, Finn, Gus, Ann, Ivo.

Check: Hana is in slot 4 and Ivo in slot 9, five apart, which is at least three. The other constraints hold by construction.
